from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The marked color is the non-background color; background is the most common color.
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seeds = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != bg]
    if not seeds:
        return out
    mark = grid[seeds[0][0]][seeds[0][1]]
    q = deque(seeds)
    seen = set(seeds)
    while q:
        r, c = q.popleft()
        for nr, nc in ((r-1,c), (r+1,c), (r,c-1), (r,c+1)):
            if 0 <= nr < h and 0 <= nc < w and grid[nr][nc] == 0 and (nr,nc) not in seen:
                seen.add((nr,nc))
                out[nr][nc] = mark
                q.append((nr,nc))
    return out

from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    vals = {v for row in grid for v in row}
    mark = next(v for v in vals if v not in (0, 3, 6))

    # Flood the zero regions using diagonal adjacency as well as orthogonal adjacency.
    q = deque((r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == mark)
    seen = set(q)
    while q:
        r, c = q.popleft()
        for dr in (-1, 0, 1):
            for dc in (-1, 0, 1):
                if dr == dc == 0:
                    continue
                nr, nc = r + dr, c + dc
                if (0 <= nr < h and 0 <= nc < w and
                        grid[nr][nc] == 0 and (nr, nc) not in seen):
                    seen.add((nr, nc))
                    out[nr][nc] = mark
                    q.append((nr, nc))
    return out
